svg.title: Extended Security for Jenkins 2.541.x
svg.desc: Upstream Jenkins LTS moves from 2.541.3 on Java 17 to 2.555.1 and 2.580.2 on Java 21 only. keelinfra's 2.541.x line branches off at 2.541.3 and stays on Java 17 with the core security fixes released after it, now at 2.541.3-k4: 41 core CVEs, up to the 2026-10-28 advisory, built and tested in CI on Java 17 and 21.
